Author: Gweniaczek
Description:
[s][/s][center][s]                                                                                                                                          
[/s]
[color=#dd7e6b][size=4]I Upload my mods ONLY on Nexusmods.com  Do NOT reupload them elsewhere without permission.
[/size]
[/color][s]                                                                                                                                             
[/s]﻿
Content pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alterative Textures mod[/url]﻿. With this mod you will be able to use multiple designs of my craftables at the same time. 

Available also as a Content Patcher pack here -> [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5513]Gwen's Craftables[/url]﻿[/center][s][/s][center][s]﻿                                                                                                                                                                            [/s]
[b]
[/b][b][color=#a2c4c9][size=4]Colour matching files for:
[/size][/color][/b]
- Vanilla ( original Stardew Valley palette ) 
- [url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/580620-eemies-just-a-new-map-recolour-content-patcher-edition]Eemie's Just A New Map Recolour[/url]﻿
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1869]Starblue Valley[/url]﻿
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/url]﻿
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2995]A Wittily Named Recolor[/url]

[color=#a2c4c9][size=4][b]Installation:[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#e06666]SMAPI and Alternative Textures mod nedeed![/color]
1. Download the file matching your recolour mod ( or Vanilla )
2. Unzip/Extract
3. Paste '[AT] Gwen's Craftables for [your choice]' folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder

[s]                                                                                                                                                                             [/s]

If you like this one then take a look at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/51171631?tab=user+files]my other mods[/url]﻿ c: 
For matching buildings see  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4542]Medieval Buildings[/url][/center][center]﻿[/center][center][s]                                                                                                                                                                             [/s]

[b][color=#a2c4c9][size=3]Does this mod include all craftables from my CP retexture?[/size][/color][/b]
Yes. It misses only few details like portrait change for telephone machine and small weather-based changes for scarecrows.

[b][color=#a2c4c9][size=3]The items are doubled in the bucked menu![/size][/color][/b]
Most of the craftables have Indoors & Outdoors versions.
Indoors won't have seasonal vines/foliage and won't be covered with snow in winter.
You can filter Outdoors/Indoors versions when choosing textures.[/center]
